description: This file defines the HeadersInterface in the Slim Framework's PSR-7 implementation, outlining methods for managing HTTP headers such as adding, removing, retrieving, and setting headers.

classes.name: HeadersInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing HTTP headers, specifying methods for adding, removing, retrieving, and setting headers in a HTTP message.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a header value; appends the value to existing values for the header.

methods.name: removeHeader
methods.description: Removes a header identified by its name from the header collection.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves header values; returns a single value if only one exists or an array of values if multiple exist.

methods.name: setHeader
methods.description: Replaces the value of a header with the provided value.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Replaces all existing headers with a new set of headers.

methods.name: hasHeader
methods.description: Checks if a header is present.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers, optionally preserving original case.
